keyFindings.description: GitHub reports the pull request CONFLICTING. git merge-tree of f4fdbf98 with main 88818a3b conflicts in pmdoc/find.go, against #2480 (71e31498), which replaced QuoteFinder.find with matches/NearestFirst and removed FindDiscardingMiss. The !f.valid gate must move into main's matches. mutation.go and AGENTS.md auto-merge with #2480's 192-line upload change, so the merge head needs a build and the write-corpus differential and race run again.

At the head the exported Splice, BlockIndex, BlockBoundary, BlockRange, BlockDescendantIDs, DeleteTextblock and InsertTableRows have no caller outside tests (base cd5ca7c3 had 14). Each operation now has two entry points and a nil branch that calls from the method to the function and back. valid_methods_test.go and TestUpdateDocumentWritesWhatUpdateWrites compare a function with a method that shares its core, so they are forwarding tests (implement.json trickyParts says so). The ValidDocument.BlockIndex method has no production caller.

splice.go:18 and :184 build ValidDocument{doc: doc} directly, which makes valid_document.go:6-10 false ('Only ValidateDocument and ReadUnshared make one'). That comment's list of methods is also out of date.
Plain applyOperations (edits.go:591) has no production caller now. Its comment says it is the batch a caller holding a plain tree applies.

AGENTS.md:573-580 and the changelog fragment line 7 claim more than the code does. The repair read of applyOpsUnconditional is treeOf(doc) on the fork (mutation.go:1316, pmdoc.Read with ToDelta). The version capture drops its ValidDocument (mutation.go:1645) and renders with documentMarkdownWithOffsets, which validates again (mutation.go:1689). The method list names BlockIndex, but the edit path calls BlockIndexes.

find.go:359 says the count 'can never come out short'. That is false for invalid UTF-8: WriteRune(RuneError) writes 3 bytes where len counted 1. flattened_text_test.go:9-11 says a miscount would shift positions, but the count only sets capacity.
write_corpus_test.go:381: the step parameter of apply is never used, because the step of the closure it returns shadows it.

declined: Nine refusal helpers take pmdoc.ValidDocument and use only .Node(): the type records that before is the validated tree that matchBlocks was computed against. That is an invariant of the type, not a defect.

equalYTextPText repeats the item-run merge rule: the walk exists to avoid allocations. A shared iterator in that hot path risks bringing allocations back, so the fix is not clear. The differential test and the deep review's 20,000-case random differential hold it to the delta comparison.
The before string with "" as its sentinel, and the growth of edits.go: both are documented design choices, not defects.
ValidateDocument's error text for a tree whose root is not a doc: no edit path reaches it (deep review finding 1).
